concerns.text: FR-005 mandates the hard 6-hour timeout with checkpoint saving for the training process generally (See US-1, US-2), but only T005 (fixed baselines) implements the epoch-start timeout check and checkpoint saving. The adaptive and shuffled-control runs in T007 and the thin run in T004 have no timeout-enforcement or checkpointing coverage, so FR-005 is only partially covered.

FR-001 requires downloading AND preprocessing the bigbench_lite logical-deduction subset in addition to GSM8K. T002 loads it, but no subsequent task (T004, T005, T007, T008) uses it for training or evaluation — all runs operate exclusively on GSM8K. The second dataset has no consuming task, leaving FR-001's preprocessing/usage half-covered.

The active contract defines a SINGLE StatisticalResult object with required fields t_test_result, quadratic_coefficients, peak_density, sensitivity_slopes, entropy_error_correlation, analysis_timestamp. Tasks write four separate JSON files (paired_t_test.json, quadratic_fit.json, sensitivity_analysis.json, entropy_error_corr.json), none of which can individually validate against the schema; T013's contract tests would fail. No task produces the consolidated schema-conformant object required by SC-006.

US-1 scenario 3 requires logging 'step-level accuracy' and the per-step density value in the metadata file. T004/T005 record only loss_trajectory, final metrics, and density_time_series (adaptive only); no task implements step-level accuracy logging, so this acceptance scenario has no covering task.

Plan element coverage gap: the plan mandates ten seeds (42–51) per condition and a power analysis 'confirming ≥ 0.80 with ten seeds' (Phase 5f). Tasks run only five seeds (42–46) and T009's power analysis merely reports 'the limitation versus the plan's ≥0.80 target' — no task satisfies the plan's ten-seed element, and the reduction is documented only in run metadata rather than reconciled in the planning artifacts.

SC-005 measures the total wall-clock time of the full experiment suite against the 6-hour limit. No task aggregates or reports suite-level wall-clock time; only per-run runtime_seconds exists. The success criterion has no producing task.

T002's verification command `print(len(d))` on a streaming IterableDataset will raise TypeError (streaming datasets do not support len()); the stated checkable completion condition is not executable as written and should be rephrased (e.g., count via islice).
